metadata.title: Res Nova: Geometrically Ordered Dynamics and Information Tension — Dual-Channel Action, Covariant Completion, and Formal Verification
metadata.description: SUPERSEDED IN PART (2026-09-20). This deposit's earlier description presented the dual-channel branch as the live result. Two of its foundations were retired after it was written and the description is corrected here. RETIRED: (a) the interpolation function mu_dual(x) = x/(1+x), together with its kinetic function F_dual, was falsified 2026-09-12 -- it fails the solar-system screening bound, driving anomalous Mercury perihelion precession ~10^3x the INPOP10a limit; the surviving branch is mu_std(x) = x/sqrt(1+x^2). The Pade[1/1] uniqueness argument remains true as mathematics ABOUT F_dual, but mu_std is not a Pade function, so it does not transfer. (b) The linear screening chain quoted previously (F''/F' ~ 0.004 reducing a 76x structure overproduction to 0.4%) and the Vainshtein solar-system quadrupole Q_2 ~ 4.9e-29 s^-2 are VOID, not merely superseded: the covariant completion is now Skordis-Zlosnik AeST on the tracking branch, where a_0, mu(x) and lambda_s do not enter linear cosmology at all. The Q_2 route was demoted to a magnitude heuristic on 2026-09-20; the binding solar-system constraint is instead lambda_s <~ 2.2, derived from the Cassini limit on Saturn's anomalous precession (Hees et al. 2014 PRD 89:102002). RETRACTED: the pre-registered a_0(z) test previously reported as favouring constant a_0 over horizon-tied a_0(z) = xi*cH(z) at 5.9 sigma is withdrawn. That figure was extracted under the falsified mu_dual. Re-extracted under mu_std it is INCONCLUSIVE at 2.06 sigma (chi^2 12.886 vs 8.645, delta chi^2 = +4.242) and the sign of the preference reverses; a sensitivity scan shows the verdict flips across the +/-30% a_0-extraction range. CORRECTED MEASUREMENT: a_0 = 1.1607e-10 m/s^2, 68% [1.059, 1.232]e-10, on the full SPARC 175-galaxy sample (3,391 points, frozen harness). The previously quoted a_0 = (1.116 +/- 0.161)e-10 was a 171-galaxy pre-audit extraction under mu_dual and is retained upstream for provenance only. a_0 is a property of the (mu, a_0) pair, not of a_0 alone: on one frozen harness the same data give 9.2420e-11 under mu_dual and 1.16067e-10 under mu_std, a 25.6% closure effect, with the rows pairwise disjoint at 68%. WHAT STANDS: ghost-freedom with tensor speed c_T = c; the Cartan Triality fermion generation count N_gen = 3; the Ramanujan-Chladni nodal mass hierarchy; and the machine checking itself -- the Lean 4 suite builds with zero sorry and axioms restricted to {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}. Module counts are scope-dependent and were previously misquoted as 21: the gate scope is 59 targets and the manuscript scope is 28 (gate scope minus ADJACENT_MODULES.txt); see docs/COUNTS.md. Machine-checked mathematics is not a claim that the physical identification holds. A pre-registered, fail-closed N-body test of the cosmological sector (D5) is included in this version: gevolution (particle-mesh, 256³ particles, 200 Mpc/h box, seed 42) patched so that G_eff(a,k) multiplies the Poisson kernel (Hassani & Lombriser 2020), run as a two-arm campaign (α=1 theory; α=0.01 negative control) against a ΛCDM baseline with identical initial conditions, under a hash-frozen pre-registration. The pipeline-sensitivity gate passes: the negative control shows a +22.2% median power enhancement at low k (linear prediction +20.4%). The theory arm (α=1) yields an INCONCLUSIVE verdict — nonlinear amplification reaches 3.0% (worst bin, k = 1.35 h/Mpc, z = 1), above the 1% consistency bound but below the 5% tension threshold — so the cosmological target D5 remains open with a measured ΔP/P table. No manuscript claim rests on this result. The negative-control gate also detected and refused to certify a build defect (MG patch compiled out) before publication, demonstrating the falsification apparatus. Raw particle snapshots are excluded from the deposit (bit-regenerable from seed 42 and the frozen parameters); power spectra, logs, verdicts, and all analysis code are included.
